verdict.rationale: Kong documents an official "Kong Konnect MCP Server" page, and a probe confirmed the official MCP server documentation exists. The evidence is only that page title and the probe, with no detail on how an agent connects, which tools it exposes, or how auth works. Kong's MCP autogeneration and MCP traffic gateway features are about governing customers' own MCP servers, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented agent connection and setup steps, tool and resource coverage, auth details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
